=={{header|FreeBASIC}}==
FreeBASIC does not have any specific built-in features for secure memory management of secrets.

However, it does provide:
# Direct memory management via CAllocate/Deallocate to ensure that sensitive data is properly erased
# Direct memory access via its pointer management capability

References:

# FreeBASIC Memory Management: https://www.freebasic.net/wiki/KeyPgMemoryManagement
# FreeBASIC Pointer Operations: https://www.freebasic.net/wiki/KeyPgPointers
